title: Human-Governed SkillOps Vertical Slice for SEC QA

steps.name: Skill Registry
steps.summary: Wrapped existing SEC-specific patches as governed skill cards with status, scope, risk, and eval metadata.

steps.name: Grep Evidence Probe
steps.summary: Added structured lexical evidence anchors: exact phrase, regex, metric alias, period phrase, and nearby number.

steps.name: Evidence Preview
steps.summary: Unified retrieval chunks, grep anchors, final answer, and skill traces into auditable JSON/Markdown previews.

steps.name: Failure Explainer
steps.summary: Added rule-based failure diagnosis over evidence previews and run rows.

steps.name: Skill Candidate Proposal
steps.summary: Generated proposal-only YAML/Markdown candidate skills from FailureReport without writing production code.

steps.name: Regression Gate
steps.summary: Added conservative gate decisions over proposals and eval summaries; candidates stay proposed without human review.

case_studies.name: Success Control: Lotus Revenue Question
case_studies.role: Correct answer with aligned retrieval and grep anchors
case_studies.result: Failure explainer returns no_failure_detected; no skill proposal is generated.
case_studies.interpretation: This case shows the loop does not hallucinate failures or propose unnecessary skills for a clean successful answer.

case_studies.name: Failure/Repair: NVIDIA FY2025 Export-Control Source Conflict
case_studies.role: Previously incorrect answer repaired by source-conflict skill and diagnosed by Failure Explainer
case_studies.result: Failure explainer classifies source_conflict with 0.95 confidence; proposal generator emits two proposed skills.
case_studies.interpretation: This case demonstrates the research loop: evidence preview exposes the issue, diagnosis classifies it, candidate generation proposes bounded fixes, and the gate keeps them proposed until review.

known_gaps: The loop currently summarizes existing run artifacts; it is not yet a single end-to-end command over arbitrary new questions.
Failure explainer is rule-based and should later be evaluated for diagnosis precision/recall.
Grep probe is a lexical audit side-channel, not an answerer; aliases and Chinese-English expansion need systematic company-profile support.
Regression gate uses protected-set summaries and manual-review flags; full implementation-specific reruns are still future work.
Candidate proposals are proposal-only by design and require human review before implementation.
